turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail: Within 15 minutes of placing an order, you can choose a faster shipping method if available and pay for the upgrade during the editing process on the order confirmation page. Next Day Delivery is available to UK customers only. The cut-off is 23:00 Sunday–Friday and 22:00 on Saturday, although cut-off times may differ during peak periods and bank holidays. Delivery dates shown at checkout are estimates only. You can view the available options and estimated dates on our Delivery Information page.

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail: Assistant: Once your order has been dispatched, you’ll receive an email within 24 hours with a VIEW AND TRACK YOUR ORDER button. Select this to view your tracking number and courier. You can then use the tracking number on the courier’s website for accurate updates. You can also track your order in the account section. Please note that tracking information can take 24–48 hours to become available after purchase. If you have your tracking number but the link is not updating, enter it on Parcels.
